headline: SILVER HITS 8-MONTH LOW AND BOUNCES — PHYSICAL BUYERS STEP IN AT $58.40 AS BRENT RETREATS AND GOLD-SILVER RATIO COMPRESSES TO 69.5
snippet: Silver spot price hit an 8-month low of approximately $56.87 on Thursday July 23, 2026, then bounced to $58.40 (+1.98%) on Friday July 24 as Brent crude retreated below $100/barrel after the prior session's 7% Iran-strike surge. Physical buyers stepped into the dip ahead of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, compressing the gold-silver ratio from 70.72 to 69.5 — a 1.72-point move in a single session — while gold steadied at $4,056 on central-bank bid support. For junior silver investors, the 8-month low followed by a single-session physical-demand recovery is a pattern that has historically preceded larger silver outperformance phases: when silver sells off harder than gold on macro fear and then recovers faster on industrial demand, the ratio compression has tended to run until the macro catalyst resolves. The July 29 FOMC decision is the binary that resolves the current setup — a hold releases silver's pent-up demand premium against the sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces, while a hike extends the compression but from a historically depressed base where physical demand has demonstrably established a floor.

headline: SILVER UP 1.5%, OIL UP 3% ON IRAN AIRSTRIKES — GOLDSILVER.COM: DIVERGENCE REVEALS SILVER'S PHYSICAL DEMAND FLOOR AT $56-58
snippet: A GoldSilver.com analysis published around July 24, 2026 addresses the apparent paradox from the prior trading week: silver rose 1.5% on the same day oil rose 3% on Iran escalation — two moves that normally don't coexist, since oil spikes trigger inflation and rate-hike fears that suppress silver. The explanation: Brent was retreating from its prior session's 7% spike, unwinding the rate-hike premium embedded in two-year Treasury yields and releasing physical silver's industrial demand component. Silver's dual identity as an inflation hedge and industrial metal means it trades with oil on the initial shock and then against oil on the reversal, compressing the gold-silver ratio from both directions within the same week. GoldSilver.com argues this pattern has empirically established a physical demand floor under silver in the $56-58 range: below that level, solar PV, EV production, and AI data-center builds absorb available supply faster than speculative selling creates it. The sixth consecutive annual silver supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces is the structural mechanism that makes the floor durable rather than coincidental — and the Iran-oil week is the stress-test that confirmed it held.

headline: OSISKO METALS RETURNS 320m AT 0.38% Cu AND A 30m ZONE AT 3.49% Cu AT GASPÉ — EASTERN NORTH AMERICA'S BIGGEST UNDEVELOPED COPPER PORPHYRY EXPANDS (TSX: OM)
snippet: Osisko Metals Inc. (TSX: OM; OTCQX: OMZNF) announced July 23, 2026 new drill results from the 2026 program at the Gaspé Copper Project in eastern Québec — the largest undeveloped copper resource in eastern North America at 1.83 billion measured and indicated tonnes grading 0.27% copper. The best new intercept is 320.5 metres averaging 0.38% copper from 25 mineralized intervals across 12 new drill holes, including a 30-metre zone at 3.49% copper with 18.4 g/t silver from 224 metres depth. Notably, several intercepts sit within the modeled waste rock of the 2026 Whittle open-pit design — meaning conversion to resource adds tonnage without expanding the pit footprint and directly improves project economics. The 2026 drill program targets conversion of remaining inferred resources to measured and indicated, and lateral expansion toward the Needle East and Needle Mountain zones to the south and southwest. At $6.30/lb copper, Gaspé's profile — 1.83 billion tonnes confirmed, located in Québec's mining-friendly Gaspé Peninsula, with existing infrastructure and consistent year-over-year drill-program expansion — positions it as one of the more derisked development-stage copper assets in Canada for institutional capital that needs brownfield copper pipeline exposure before the Rook I and Cobre Panama timelines resolve.

headline: BARRICK COMMENCES EXPLORATION ON MIDLAND'S 86 KM² LEWIS PROJECT IN ABITIBI — OPTION TO EARN 75% WITH $12M COMMITMENT BY 2032 (TSXV: MD)
snippet: Midland Exploration Inc. (TSXV: MD) announced July 23, 2026 that Barrick Gold Inc. has commenced the 2026 exploration program at the Lewis Project in Québec's Abitibi region. Lewis spans 154 exclusive exploration rights across approximately 86 km² under an option agreement signed in November 2025 that allows Barrick to earn up to a 75% interest by making $750,000 in staged cash payments and funding $12 million in exploration expenditures by 2032 — with Barrick as operator and designer of all work programs. The 2026 program focuses on geological mapping with structural measurements and a project-scale till sampling survey with 167 planned sample sites — Barrick's standard generative targeting methodology applied before committing to a drill program. For junior mining investors, a Barrick-operated joint venture on an Abitibi property is among the highest-conviction validation signals available: the world's second-largest gold producer's technical team has evaluated the regional geology and committed $12 million and seven years of work to earn a 75% interest, at a gold price of $4,066/oz where every exploration dollar has highest-ever purchasing power in constant terms. If Barrick's till survey identifies a priority target, a drill program and potential NI 43-101 resource follow — a sequenced pathway to discovery that has historically unlocked junior equity re-ratings 2-3x the cost of the initial option.

headline: T2 METALS FINDS 15%+ VISUAL CHALCOPYRITE AND NEW ANTIMONY VEINS AT AURORA YUKON — SHAWN RYAN PROJECT HEADS TO RAB DRILLING THIS SUMMER (TSXV: TWO)
source_name: Investing News Network / T2 Metals Corp.
snippet: T2 Metals Corp. (TSXV: TWO) provided a July 23, 2026 exploration update at its Aurora Gold-Silver Project in Yukon's Tombstone Gold Belt — acquired from renowned Yukon prospector Shawn Ryan — reporting two distinct new sulphide discoveries during summer 2026 fieldwork. Semi-massive stibnite (antimony sulphide) mineralization was found in outcrop approximately 300 metres from the Antimony Mountain prospect; a separate rock float sample 300 metres northeast of the Rainbow prospect returned chalcopyrite (copper sulphide) with visual grades exceeding 15% — exceptionally high for a float sample and the kind of anomaly that generates priority drill targeting. Drill site preparation is underway for a rotary air blast program planned for July/August 2026. T2 has collected more than 120 rock samples and 3,000 soil samples across a 10 km by 5 km coverage area. Aurora hosts eight historical gold-bearing prospects along a 10 km trend in the Tombstone Gold Belt and has received less than 3,000 metres of historical drilling — a classic under-drilled, district-scale Yukon property where modern systematic sampling on the structural model has already generated two geochemical/mineralogical anomalies the historical program missed. The Shawn Ryan provenance adds exploration methodology credibility: Ryan pioneered the till sampling approach that led to the White Gold District discoveries.

headline: ALTAMIRA GOLD EXTENDS MARIA BONITA PORPHYRY 110m NORTH OF RESOURCE — MBA039 RETURNS 117m AT 0.4 g/t AU FROM SURFACE IN BRAZIL (TSXV: ALTA)
source_name: Investing News Network / Altamira Gold Corp.
snippet: Altamira Gold Corp. (TSXV: ALTA) reported July 23, 2026 assay results from exploration drilling 110 metres north-west of the existing Maria Bonita mineral resource at its Cajueiro District Project in Pará State, Brazil. Hole MBA039 intersected 117 metres grading 0.40 g/t gold from surface in volcanic tuffs — a wide, surface-to-depth interval wholly outside the current resource model. Hole MBA038 returned 74 metres grading 0.30 g/t gold from 74 metres depth at the porphyry-tuff contact zone. Both holes confirm the mineralized system extends north and west beyond the current resource boundary and at depth. The Cajueiro porphyry system's surface-hosted mineralization at 100m+ widths in an established Pará State gold province — Brazil's most prolific — is the signature of a scalable bulk-tonnage deposit where each step-out adds resource conversion potential at low marginal discovery cost. For investors tracking the junior gold porphyry space: at $4,066 gold, Altamira's ability to consistently hit wide, low-to-moderate-grade intercepts outside its existing resource is the systematic resource-building approach that resolves into preliminary economic assessments as the deposit footprint reaches the scale required for economic open-pit mining.

headline: ENERGY FUELS STARTS PHASE 2 WHITE MESA HEAVY REE CIRCUIT — TERBIUM, DYSPROSIUM, GADOLINIUM TARGETED FOR U.S. PRODUCTION BY LATE 2027 (NYSE: EFRS)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: EFRS; TSX: EFR) commenced Phase 2 modifications to the rare earth element processing circuits at the White Mesa Mill in Utah in July 2026 — the most significant expansion of domestic U.S. rare earth refining capacity since Phase 1 began producing commercial separated neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide. Phase 2 targets commercial production of samarium, europium, gadolinium, terbium, and dysprosium — the five heavy rare earth elements in which China holds an estimated 98%+ global refining share and which are critical inputs for defense-grade permanent magnets, advanced EV motors, and precision guidance systems. The Phase 2 circuits are expected to reach operational status in late 2027 to early 2028. Separately, Energy Fuels achieved its full-year 2026 uranium production guidance of 1.5-2.5 million pounds U3O8 by mid-year — six months ahead of schedule — demonstrating the operational capacity to run uranium and rare earth campaigns simultaneously at the same mill. White Mesa is the only U.S. facility currently producing separated NdPr from domestic monazite ore; Phase 2 completion would make it the only U.S. facility producing separated heavy rare earths at commercial scale, a strategic asset that has attracted Department of Defense interest and grant support under the National Defense Authorization Act.

headline: AUSTRALIAN GOLD & COPPER DRILLS 26m AT 102 g/t AgEq FROM 433m AT ACHILLES — SYSTEM NOW OPEN TO 540m DIP, 290m BELOW CURRENT RESOURCE (ASX: AGC)
source_name: Discovery Alert / Australian Gold and Copper Ltd.
snippet: Australian Gold and Copper Ltd. (ASX: AGC) completed its depth-extension drill program at the Achilles mineral system at Cargelligo, New South Wales, with the final holes confirming the system remains open and fertile to at least 540 metres down-dip — approximately 290 metres below the current resource envelope. The deepest hole, A3DD014, returned approximately 26 metres at 102 g/t silver equivalent from 433 metres depth, including a 15-metre zone at 153 g/t AgEq and a 2-metre bonanza interval at approximately 770 g/t AgEq. Companion hole A3DD015 returned 14 metres at 85 g/t AgEq from 388 metres, with a 1-metre interval at 400 g/t AgEq. Managing Director Glen Diemar stated the Achilles system 'remains open and fertile hundreds of metres below the current resource.' The combination of high-grade bonanza intervals at depth — 770 g/t, 400 g/t — alongside consistent large-width intercepts across multiple holes at 400-540 metres is the VMS/skarn geological signature that attracts mid-tier acquirer attention as the resource base builds to the scale where open-underground production economics become demonstrably viable. For ASX junior silver investors, Achilles' depth extension adds resource conversion potential in the highest-grade portions of the deposit, where each additional metre drilled adds disproportionate ounce-per-tonne value to the eventual MRE.

headline: PALADIN ENERGY HIKES LANGER HEINRICH GUIDE TO 5.1-5.6M LBS U3O8 — SHARES UP 5%; US$44-48/LB AISC MAKES IT ONE OF THE WORLD'S LOWEST-COST URANIUM MINES (ASX/TSX: PDN)
snippet: Paladin Energy Ltd. (ASX: PDN; TSX: PDN) raised its FY2026-27 production guidance for the Langer Heinrich Mine in Namibia to 5.1-5.6 million pounds of U3O8 at an all-in sustaining cost of US$44-48/lb — compared to the current uranium spot price of approximately $86/lb, implying a net margin of US$38-42/lb, among the highest per-pound returns in the uranium sector globally. Shares gained approximately 5% on the announcement on July 22, 2026. The company also upgraded FY2026 guidance to 4.5-4.8 million pounds (from 4.0-4.4 million pounds) after producing 3.6 million pounds in the first half alone, citing smooth mining ramp-up, higher feed grades, and strong metallurgical recovery rates. For uranium equity investors mapping the sector at $86/lb spot, Langer Heinrich at US$44-48/lb AISC and 5.1-5.6 million pounds of annual production represents a current, derisked cash-flow profile that most uranium developers cannot offer before 2028-2030. The FY2026-27 guidance raise signals Paladin's technical team has confidence in the mine plan delivering at the high end of capacity — a different risk-return proposition from NexGen's higher-margin Rook I (US$15.57/lb AISC at full capacity) that remains four years from first production, or Cameco's McClean Lake-dependent Cigar Lake operation which demonstrated supply vulnerability in its July 2026 two-week curtailment.
